title: Add <meta charset="utf-8"> to index.html (flag emoji render as mojibake)
description: index.html has no <meta charset> in <head>, so the document is served as text/html with no charset and the browser sniffs Latin-1, rendering flag emoji as mojibake (e.g. 'MOUNT EVEREST ðŸ‡¨ðŸ‡³' instead of 🇨🇳). Confirmed identical on release and on the ulv.2 branch — pre-existing, not caused by the data-driven refactor; surfaced while verifying ulv.2. Fix: add <meta charset="utf-8"> as the first child of <head> in index.html. Files on disk are already UTF-8. Verify: load the site, check .mount-everest-title textContent === 'MOUNT EVEREST 🇨🇳' across browsers; Playwright smoke stays green.

title: Refactor: data-driven mountains, inert scene layer, centralized canvas constants
description: Pre-feature refactor of how-tall-is-mount-everest (single 50,000px scrollable canvas, kept as-is). Fixes three structural problems: (1) adding a mountain takes 5 coordinated edits that drift out of sync; (2) the mountain layer is only loosely inert; (3) canvas dimensions are duplicated magic numbers across Metronome.tsx and index.css. Source: REFACTOR_PLAN.md. Outcome: adding a mountain becomes drop-SVG + one data row; one inert decorative scene layer; canvas height defined once in TypeScript. Children: canvas-constants (P3), data-driven-mountains (P1), scene-layer (P2), remove-dead-code (P4), verification.

title: Centralize canvas constants (scene.ts, Metronome, main.tsx, index.css)

title: Refactor: data-driven mountains, inert scene layer, centralized canvas constants
description: Pre-feature refactor of how-tall-is-mount-everest (one 50,000px scrollable canvas, kept as-is). Outcome: adding a mountain becomes drop-an-SVG-in-the-folder + add-one-data-row; the mountain layer becomes a single provably-inert decorative scene; the canvas height is defined once in TypeScript. Files across phases: src/config/scene.ts (new), src/components/Metronome/Metronome.tsx, src/main.tsx, src/index.css, src/components/Mountains/{mountainsInfo.ts, Mountains.tsx, Mountain.tsx}, tailwind.config.js, src/App.tsx, src/components/Animations/{Stars,Ashes,Clouds}.tsx, src/components/Illustrations/Illustrations.tsx. Source plan: .claude/plans/REFACTOR_PLAN.md.
design:
Three structural problems make the codebase hard to extend before adding features:
1. Adding a mountain takes 5 coordinated edits across the SVG asset, a bg-mountain-N entry in tailwind.config.js, the mountainVariants map in Mountain.tsx, the MountainID union in Mountains.tsx, and the data row in mountainsInfo.ts. These drift out of sync (entries past mountain-18 all point at top-[12500px]).
2. The mountain layer is only loosely inert (a single pointer-events-none per Mountain div) with no formal decorative layer.
3. Canvas dimensions are duplicated magic numbers (50000/6800/2500/350 in Metronome.tsx and --page-height/--half-page-height in index.css), defined in three places.

title: Centralize canvas constants (scene.ts, Metronome, main.tsx, index.css)
description: Section 3. Create a single source of truth for canvas dimensions and stop duplicating them across TS and CSS. Foundational: the data-driven mountain phase imports SUMMIT_OFFSET and MOUNTAIN_SPACING from the new scene.ts.
acceptance_criteria:
- src/config/scene.ts exists exporting PAGE_HEIGHT, MAP_HEIGHT, SUMMIT_OFFSET, MOUNTAIN_SPACING.
- Metronome.tsx imports those constants; no literal 50000/6800/2500 remain; 350/100 kept as named locals.
- Scroll handler wrapped in a requestAnimationFrame ticking guard.
- main.tsx injects --page-height and --half-page-height from PAGE_HEIGHT on boot.
- Hardcoded --page-height/--half-page-height removed from :root in index.css; rest intact.
- Scroll and meter behaviour identical to before.
close_reason: Implemented on refactor/ulv.1-canvas-constants: js/scene.js single source of truth + rAF scroll throttle; verified in-browser

title: Data-driven mountain system (eliminate the 5-edit gotcha)
description: Section 1. Make mountainsInfo.ts the single source of truth and derive image, vertical position, and z-index instead of hardcoding them across three files.
design:
mountainsInfo.ts: discover SVGs via Vite glob and build a filename->URL lookup; resolve each row asset through it; throw a clear error on a missing asset:
  const svgUrls = import.meta.glob('../../assets/mountains/*.svg', { eager: true, query: '?url', import: 'default' }) as Record<string, string>;
Reshape rows to MountainConfig keyed by asset filename: { asset, name, altitude, location, prominence, range, firstAscent, difficulty }.
Mountains.tsx: remove the MountainID union; export MountainConfig (PascalCase); derive top = SUMMIT_OFFSET + index * MOUNTAIN_SPACING and zIndex = index + 1; pass resolved src/top/zIndex to Mountain.
Mountain.tsx: delete the mountainVariants map; apply position/image via inline style { top: `${top}px`, zIndex, backgroundImage: `url(${src})` }; keep static size and bg-cover classes.
tailwind.config.js: remove the 25 bg-mountain-N entries (keep clouds, grids, floor-to-sky gradients).
acceptance_criteria:
- mountainsInfo.ts discovers SVGs via import.meta.glob and resolves filename->URL, throwing on a missing asset.
- MountainConfig (PascalCase) exported; MountainID union removed.
- mountainVariants map deleted; Mountain.tsx sets top/zIndex/backgroundImage via inline style; size + bg-cover kept.
- The 25 bg-mountain-N entries removed from tailwind.config.js (clouds/grids/floor-to-sky kept).
- All 25 SVGs render at even index-derived spacing (top = SUMMIT_OFFSET + index*MOUNTAIN_SPACING).
- Adding a mountain = drop N-NAME.svg in src/assets/mountains/ + add one data row.
close_reason: Done. PR #61 (https://github.com/feraranas/how-tall-is-mount-everest/pull/61), base release. Data-driven: 41 peaks generated from js/mountainsData-script.js into #mountains-root; ~1170 lines removed from index.html; bespoke per-breakpoint CSS preserved via slug classes. Playwright smoke 15/15 green x2 (firefox scroll flake fixed via condition-based waiting); PR MERGEABLE/CLEAN; verified at runtime: 41 .mountain-svg nodes render, .mount-everest-svg top=3336px, Half Dome header intact. Note: pre-existing emoji mojibake (missing <meta charset> in index.html) confirmed identical on release — tracked as separate follow-up, not a regression.

title: Non-interactive scene layer (lock it down robustly)
description: Section 2. Wrap the mountains in one decorative layer that is provably inert and sits behind future interactive UI.
design:
In Mountains.tsx (or a thin new Scene wrapper rendered in App.tsx), wrap the mapped mountains in:
  <div aria-hidden className="absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-full pointer-events-none select-none">
absolute + h-full keeps the wrapper out of normal flow (so it does not double the body height) and gives the absolutely-positioned mountains an explicit positioned ancestor.
Mountain.tsx: add draggable={false} as belt-and-suspenders against native drag ghosts.
Keep Metronome (z-[99]) outside/above this layer as the interactive UI layer.
acceptance_criteria:
- Mapped mountains wrapped in a div with aria-hidden and classes: absolute top-0 left-0 w-full h-full pointer-events-none select-none.
- Each Mountain has draggable={false}.
- Mountains cannot be dragged, drag-ghosted, or text-selected; labels cannot be highlighted.
- Metronome (z-99) remains above the scene layer.
close_reason: Done. PR #62 (https://github.com/feraranas/how-tall-is-mount-everest/pull/62), stacked on #61 (retarget base to release after #61 merges). Vanilla adaptation: #mountains-root -> .scene-layer (user-select:none, kept static so peaks still resolve to .main-container; NOT pointer-events:none so .fa-info tabs stay interactive per maintainer decision); .mountain-svg art + title labels + Half Dome header get aria-hidden + draggable=false. Metronome z-index 200 > mountains max 115. Playwright smoke green 15/15; PR MERGEABLE/CLEAN; verified at runtime: 41/41 svgs+titles aria-hidden & non-draggable, 41 tabs pointer-events:auto with hover->.mountain-info.show-info, root user-select:none + position:static.

Run npm run build (tsc -b then vite build) — must pass; validates glob typing, MountainConfig reshape, and removal of MountainID/mountainVariants.
Run npm run lint — clean.
Run npm run dev and exercise the browser checks.
Sanity: add a throwaway 26th SVG + one data row, confirm it appears at the next position with no other edits, then revert.

- npm run lint clean.
- All 25 mountain SVGs render; intentionally breaking one filename triggers the missing-asset error.
- Scrolling updates the Metronome meter readout; the active toggle behaves at top/bottom edges.
